name: Garuda Indonesia UOB Card
welcomeBonus: Up to 15.000 GarudaMiles, with a special offer of 26.000 GarudaMiles run at times.
notes: Every figure is from PinterPoin. UOB Indonesia's and Garuda Indonesia's own pages could not be reached, so nothing is confirmed against the issuer.

From 10 March 2026 the card pays a mile per Rp 5.000 at Garuda Indonesia, per Rp 8.000 on travel, hotels and anything in a foreign currency, and per Rp 12.000 on everything else. The change was mixed rather than a devaluation: Garuda spending improved from Rp 6.666 a mile, the travel and foreign tier is new, and ordinary spending fell from Rp 10.000.

Spending at Garuda Indonesia is a merchant, not a category, so it is matched two ways at the same priority: by the name on the transaction line, and by Garuda's own merchant category code 3103. A rule's own conditions are combined with AND, so one rule asking for both would miss every purchase that carries no code.

The travel and hotel tier is matched by the Travel category, which covers flights, hotels and activities. A travel purchase booked through a merchant this workspace files elsewhere earns the base rate instead.
Before 10 March 2026 the Garuda rate is written as 3 miles per Rp 20.000, which is the exact form of the Rp 6.666 a mile that was quoted.
The card earns GarudaMiles directly, so there is nothing to transfer.
The card converted from Citi Garuda Indonesia after UOB bought Citi's Indonesian retail business in 2023.
Not modelled: 20 kg of extra baggage on Garuda Indonesia, and a standing 10% discount when redeeming GarudaMiles at a ticketing office. Neither pays miles.
The annual fee of Rp 800.000 is described as waivable, but the conditions were not published anywhere reachable, so none are recorded.
No source lists the transactions that earn nothing, so cash advance, instalments and fees are not excluded here and such spend is overestimated.
Rounding is taken as per full increment, in line with the other entries.
